title: She Gave Gold to One Daughter and Mud to the Other

characters.name: Mrs Banana
characters.look: tall banana-headed woman with red lipstick, pearl earrings and a green satin gown

characters.name: Goldie
characters.look: little girl with a shiny golden lemon head and a cream dress

characters.name: Lemmy
characters.look: little girl with a plain yellow lemon head, sad eyes and a faded blue dress

scenes.image: mansion living room; mrs_banana pours liquid gold over goldie's head while holding a rusty bucket of mud over lemmy

lines.text: She poured gold on only one daughter.
Goldie deserves to shine. You get the mud.

scenes.image: school hallway; goldie laughs with friends while lemmy walks alone, covered in dried mud

lines.text: At school, everyone loved the golden girl. Nobody sat with Lemmy.

scenes.image: small attic bedroom at night; lemmy secretly painting a beautiful picture by candlelight

lines.text: But every night, Lemmy painted in secret.
One day, they will see me.

scenes.image: art contest stage; a judge holds up lemmy's painting while the crowd gasps

lines.text: Then a famous art contest offered one million dollars.

scenes.image: mansion; mrs_banana grabs the prize cheque, smiling greedily, goldie behind her

lines.text: Give me that money, I am her mother!

scenes.image: mansion doorway; lemmy stands proudly next to a kind old pineapple judge holding papers

lines.text: But the judge had read the painting's secret title.
It was called: The Mother Who Chose Gold.

description: One daughter got gold, the other got mud. Did the mother deserve what came next?
cliffhanger: The judge reveals what he found out about Mrs Banana's past.

brief.drama: a parent who spoils one child and neglects the other
brief.twist: the quiet one was secretly the richest all along
